Pokemon XD Unified Battle + Gen2 386 Importer v4.10.1

v4.10.1: Flying-type native locomotion unification through Gen III. For Flying-type species #001–386, when native XD PKX slot 16 is populated, walking, running, flying, and Ground Ecology hop/jump presentation all use that species' own slot-16 clip. If slot 16 is absent, the existing walk/fly/hop mapping is left unchanged. This applies across normal overworld actors, Ground Ecology, Flying Ecology, Water Ecology flight presentation, and followers because the rule is enforced in the shared XD rig. Existing v4.9.9 fly-only slot-16 behavior is preserved for other aerial ecology species. The entire v4.9.8 battle side remains unchanged. The dedicated battle pack remains 368BattlePackGen2.pack.

Select your Pokemon XD ISO/GCM once. This single builder creates the current battle stage pack + realtime battle-scene mod and the current Pokemon #001–386 XD asset pack + 368ImporterDXGen2 mod. Source game assets stay local in your browser.

Validated primarily against USA GXXE01. The two mod buttons unlock after their corresponding pack is generated because each manifest records the exact pack byte size and MD5.

Gen2 build: models, textures, skeletons and rooted animation playback come from the Pokémon XD ISO/368PackDX.
